text: I've never seen this before, but it looks like\nsome kind of god. I think the people living here\nwere worshiping this god...
This statue...You're sure it's Grecia, the Goddess\nof Courage who took you to the Dark Realm and\nsaved you from the brink of death...
You wonder what kind of people were worshiping\nGrecia...
I read a book about an ethnic minority in the\ndesert known as the Inje that believed in\nthe Goddess of Courage in the past...
Where did all the people who used to live here go?\nI don't think they had been devoured by monsters\nthough...
Hmm...we need to do a thorough search to find\nout...Nothing else seems suspicious here.\nShall we move on then?
